name: git-hex-rebaseWithPlan
description: Perform an interactive rebase with a structured plan (reorder, squash, drop, reword). Use to clean up feature branch history before merge. Use checkRebaseConflicts first if conflicts are likely. Do NOT use on shared/pushed branches without coordination.

repoPath.description: Path to git repository (optional; defaults to the single configured root if omitted)

plan.description: Ordered list of actions for each commit

message.description: New commit message. Required for reword. Must be single-line (no TAB or newline).

abortOnConflict.description: Abort and restore on conflict (default: true)

autosquash.description: Automatically squash fixup! and squash! commits (default: true)

requireComplete.description: If true, plan must include all commits in range. If false, unmentioned commits default to 'pick'.

signCommits.description: If true, allow commit signing during rebase (may prompt/hang if pinentry is required). Default false to avoid non-interactive hangs.

success.description: True if operation succeeded, false if error

commitsRebased.description: Number of commits rebased when successful

suggestions.description: Actionable suggestions for resolving the error

timeoutHint: For large rebases, split into smaller batches (5-10 commits at a time). Use getRebasePlan to understand the scope first.
